knowledge_gaps: The uniform control is documented but not fully verified: its recorded 0.5/0.5 objective conflicts with diagnostic definitions describing 0.25/0.75. Resolve this using host-supplied executable configuration and checkpoint metadata before claiming a cutoff-only comparison.

The sampler is reproducible, but the complete experiment is not yet specified: exact independent branch user draws, initialization, forward-call order, stopping-rule units, and predictor integration remain delegated to unavailable baseline helpers.
Clarify whether the four category checkpoint-selection scores reproduce the independently evaluated host predictor's macro HR@10. Their mean, 0.5975, alone does not verify that correspondence.
The affected-history percentages describe direct sampling exposure, not the fraction of users whose predictions can change. Shared model parameters can change recommendations for every user.
The remaining GPU budget and total control runtime are unspecified. Selected-epoch timing does not establish cumulative cost through early stopping, validation, diagnostics, and failures.

Originality 2 is reasonable, but potential 7 is speculative and difficulty 3 assumes working integration helpers. RSS needs a complete bibliographic reference and a precise comparison of its sampling policy with this proposal.

The uncertainty plan needs an explicit bootstrap seed, replicate count, and selection caveat. Paired resampling after checkpoint and variant selection does not correct adaptive validation overfitting; sampled HR@10 also cannot establish full-catalog improvements.
